writers.authority: HARD-GATED: raises 22023 sv_not_live unless authority='live', and (v64) refuses under an active 'all'/'earn' sv_pause. v68a adds four typed 22023 refusals, all BEFORE the first write so a refused attempt reserves no idempotency key: 'is not a top-up operation' (target symmetry with sv_chargeback_topup), sv_no_payment_evidence (no sv_topup_payments row = no cash was ever collected, so none may be paid out - the cap fails CLOSED, never open), sv_charged_back (the bank already clawed the funding back), sv_refund_not_permitted / sv_refund_unused_only / sv_refund_policy_unimplemented (the paid lot's immutable v65 plan-version refund_policy; 'full_unused' has no pinned semantics and refuses rather than silently meaning 'proportional'), and sv_cash_refund_cap. As of PS-2 LIVE, 'live' is a reachable state of the programme (v69 cutover); it is prod authority staying 'unbuilt' this phase that keeps the RPC unreachable in production. Exercised via a rolled-back authority='live' shim.
writers.kernel: REMAINDER-ONLY, SETTLEMENT-SAFE (v67), CASH-CAPPED (v68a). Writes sv_lot_movements plus the sv_topup_cash_refunds cap row; cash refund is paid-class only and bonus is never cashed out. It is reachable on a top-up whose value was partly consumed by a v67 CHECKOUT SETTLEMENT, and it needs no gate for that: the plan is computed from the lot REMAINING, so already-settled cents are structurally out of reach and every movement it writes is negative (nothing is restored). v67's suite pins the arithmetic - refunded paid + settled paid == the whole top-up's paid price - and asserts the settled sale's sale_balance and tender marker are untouched. The kernel inherits one hard rule from v68a: cash out is bounded by recorded payment evidence, never by minted value.

writers.entry_point: public.sv_chargeback_topup(business, topup_operation, reason, idempotency_key) — v68a owner-only FUNDING-CHARGEBACK RPC (PS-0 §6 case (e)). The bank reversed the funding payment, so every remaining cent of that top-up operation's paid and bonus lots is voided and the goods already delivered are reported as bad debt. THE FIRST WRITER of the 'correction' and 'bad_debt' movement kinds — before v68a the only sv_lot_movements writers were app.sv_spend_core ('spend'), record_sv_topup_sale ('issue'), refund_sv_operation ('refund'/'clawback'), sv_expire_due ('expiry') and sv_reverse_spend ('reversal'/'expiry'). No new movement kind is introduced; the PS-0 8-kind vocabulary stays closed.
writers.idempotency: sv_operations unique(business, operation_type='chargeback', idempotency_key) + request_hash of {business, topup_operation, reason} + per-account advisory xact lock + a dedicated (business, key) advisory lock + cached-result replay; a changed request under the same key raises 22023. ONE chargeback per top-up operation is enforced structurally by unique(business_id, topup_operation_id) on public.sv_chargebacks and surfaced as the typed 22023 sv_already_charged_back.
writers.value: VALUE VOIDER, NEVER A MINT. Voids exactly app.sv_lot_remaining of each lot via negative 'correction' movements (the PURE planner app.sv_chargeback_plan computes them from the existing engine helper — no parallel balance implementation). Bad debt = Σspend − Σreversal on the PAID lot and is recorded as a ZERO-CENTS 'bad_debt' movement (v61 CHECK forces cents=0), so `remaining ≡ Σ movements` (PS-0 §10.1) is untouched and the already-voided value is never double-subtracted; the loss FIGURE lives on sv_chargebacks.bad_debt_cents, the operation result and audit_log. ⚖️ The accounting TREATMENT of that figure (write-off vs contra-revenue, GST) is owner + accountant territory (PS-0 §11.3) and the RPC classifies nothing — it returns bad_debt_accounting_classification='not_classified_owner_and_accountant_review_required'. Cash already refunded before the chargeback is reported SEPARATELY as cash_already_refunded_cents and netted against nothing (contract §3 pinned default, awaiting owner ratification). The immutable v66 sv_topup_payments row is never mutated; the chargeback is append-only evidence beside it.
writers.authority: HARD-GATED: 42501 owner-only, then 22023 sv_not_live unless sv_authority.state='live' (prod stays 'unbuilt' this phase), then the v64 pause gate — a chargeback is a REDEMPTION-family correction, so an active 'all' or 'redeem' sv_pause blocks it. Also refuses a synthetic entity on a live business (v66), a funding currency that no longer matches the business currency, and a top-up with no recorded payment evidence (sv_no_payment_evidence). Authority and pause are RE-VALIDATED under the locks (TOCTOU-closed), and every refusal happens before the first write, so a refused attempt reserves no idempotency key.
writers.kernel: SEPARATE-LEDGER, SETTLEMENT-RESPECTING. Writes only the sv_lot_movements authority plus its own evidence tables; it reverses NO sale, writes no credit_ledger/points_ledger/sales row, and claws back no goods — a v67 SV-settled sale keeps reading paid and cash-basis revenue after its funding top-up is charged back (asserted in db/tests/v68a_chargeback_correction.sql). It therefore neither uses nor weakens the v67 §11a/§11b reversal refusals, which the migration asserts are still installed as a post-condition.
writers.kernel_migratability: SEPARATE-LEDGER — stored-value funding failure has no analogue in the sale/credit kernel; the chargeback is an sv-ledger correction plus a report figure, keyed through the shared house idempotency envelope.

writers.value: BOUNDED VALUE ADJUSTER, NEVER A MINT — it writes no sv_lots row at all, so the v66 tripwire (record_sv_topup_sale is the only paid-lot minter) stays green. Invariants, each a typed 22023: a correction may never drive the lot's derived remaining below 0 (sv_correction_below_zero) nor above its immutable minted_cents (sv_correction_above_mint); the exact boundary remaining==minted_cents is allowed. It touches exactly one lot (the target row is locked FOR UPDATE and no other lot is read for write). A POSITIVE correction onto a lot whose expiry_key has passed is REFUSED (sv_correct_expired_lot) — a pinned default awaiting owner ratification, chosen so PS-0 §6's "an expired lot is never silently resurrected" is not quietly broken by an owner adjustment; negative corrections on an expired lot remain available. A lot belonging to a charged-back top-up is frozen (sv_charged_back), because putting value back onto it would recreate value the bank already clawed back.
